AuthMode.title: authMode
AuthMode.description: Specifies the authorization mode to use when simulating the transaction. 'enforce' enforces authorization checks, 'record' records authorization without enforcing, and 'record_allow_nonroot' records authorization while allowing non-root invocations. When omitted for an `InvokeHostFunctionOp`, the mode is 'record' if the operation has no authorization entries and 'enforce' if it has any.
